grammar.form: What I need is…; It was John who…
grammar.meaning: putting one part of the sentence in the spotlight

explanation.en: Split the sentence to emphasise one part: 'What worries me is the cost' or 'It was the cost that worried me.'
explanation.uz: Bir qismni ajratib ko'rsatish uchun gap bo'linadi: 'What worries me is the cost' yoki 'It was the cost that worried me.'

grammar.positive_example: What I need is more time, not more money.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida ta'kid so'z tartibi bilan beriladi; ingliz tilida alohida tuzilma kerak.

grammar.label: future in the past
grammar.form: was going to; would; was about to
grammar.meaning: a plan made in the past, seen from the past

explanation.en: Use 'was going to' for a past plan, often one that did not happen: 'I was going to call, but I forgot.'
explanation.uz: O'tmishdagi reja uchun 'was going to', ko'pincha amalga oshmagan reja: 'I was going to call, but I forgot.'

grammar.positive_example: We were about to leave when the phone rang.
grammar.negative_example: We are about to leave when the phone rang.

l1_notes.uz: Amalga oshmagan reja ekani ko'pincha yo'qoladi; 'was going to' aynan shuni bildiradi.

Sentence stress — content words carry the beat

functions.label: Expressing degrees of certainty in writing

exponents.text: The evidence suggests that costs will rise.
It is likely that the deadline will move.
It appears that nobody was informed.

functions.label: Managing a conversation — interrupting and coming back

exponents.text: Sorry, could I just add something?
As I was saying, the deadline is Friday.

functions.label: Disagreeing politely and softening a refusal

exponents.text: I see your point, but I'm not sure that's the whole story.
That's true up to a point.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: What I need is time, not another computer.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Say that to Sarah. She decides.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I was going to, but she was in a meeting all day.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I was about to write her a long message, and then I stopped.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Because it is not the computer that slows me down. It is the meetings.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Then that is what you say.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: It was Sarah who asked me to join all of them.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: She would not mind you leaving two of them.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I thought she would be angry.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: What she wants is the work done. Ask her honestly.
